title: On the sunflower property and the galah property
summary: Sunflowerability, or the infinite sunflower property, was introduced and studied by Ackerman, Karker and Mirabi as a structural generalization of the well-known Δ-system lemma for sets. It turns out that for relational Fra\''issé limits with strong amalgamation, this property is equivalent to the so-called galah property, which was introduced by Sullivan and Winkel as an asymmetric variation of indivisibility.
